description.narrative: This project is an implementation project which is funded by Malaria Consortium-US grant. The main objective of the project is to accelerate control of Podoconiosis through universal access to appropriate preventive and management health services. The project will be implemented in Sodo Zuria and Offa districts of Wolaita zone, SNNPR, Ethiopia over three years from November 2022 up to October 2025. The overall outcome of the project is to contribute to reduction of the rate of new Podoconiosis cases to < 1% in Sodo Zuria and Offa districts Ethiopia, by 2025. The project envisions four major outcomes: (1) Improved access and quality of lymphedema morbidity management, disability prevention, psychological support services in PHCS of project districts. (2) Improved awareness, care seeking behavior, shoes wearing and feet hygiene practices of the community and patients with Podoconiosis through evidence based, targeted, multi-channel and gender sensitive SBCC. (3) Policy influence for improved access to and utilization of shoes for patients with Podoconiosis, school children, women and farmers living in Podoconiosis prevalent districts. (4) Empowered patients with Podoconiosis to improve their own health, social bonds and economical status. Multiple activities will be implemented towards achieving the outlined outcomes.
